title.zh: 工艺原理：不是把杂质打进去
title.en: Process principle: more than simply injecting impurities

subtitle.zh: 离子种类 /质量选择/加速/扫描
subtitle.en: Ion species / mass selection / acceleration / scanning

body.zh: 01 离子源；产生并电离所需；的杂质离子
body.en: 01 Ion source Generate and ionize the required dopant species

body.zh: 02 质量选择；分析磁铁按质荷比；选择目标离子
body.en: 02 Mass selection The analyzing magnet selects ions by mass-to-charge ratio

body.zh: 03 束流加速；加速离子到设定；注入能量
body.en: 03 Beam acceleration Accelerate ions to the specified implant energy

body.zh: 04；聚焦输运；电磁透镜聚焦并；引导束流输运
body.en: 04 Focusing and transport Electromagnetic lenses focus and guide beam transport

body.zh: 05 晶圆扫描；按设定图形和角度；扫描注入晶圆
body.en: 05 Wafer scanning Scan and implant the wafer at specified pattern and angle

body.zh: 06 退火与量测；退火修复损伤；并进行量测评估
body.en: 06 Anneal and metrology Anneal to repair damage and assess by metrology

body.zh: 离子种类；B⁺；P⁺；As⁺；Sb⁺；选择合适的掺杂离子；满足器件需求
body.en: Ion species B⁺ P⁺ As⁺ Sb⁺ Choose suitable dopant ions to meet device needs

body.zh: 束流纯度；质荷比；提高目标离子比例；减少杂散离子
body.en: Beam purity Mass-to-charge ratio Increase the target-ion fraction and reduce unwanted ions

body.zh: 注入能量；决定离子穿透深度；影响结深与分布
body.en: Implant energy Determines ion penetration depth and affects junction depth and distribution

body.zh: 剂量与角度；决定注入浓度与横向分布；影响阈值与漏电
body.en: Dose and angle Determines implant concentration and lateral distribution and affects threshold voltage and leakage

body.zh: 核心提示；注入导入原子，退火与量测决定它是否成为可用掺杂
body.en: Key point Implantation introduces atoms; annealing and metrology determine usable doping

body.zh: 耦合提示；能量、剂量、角度共同影响深度、损伤与最终电性
body.en: Coupling Energy, dose and angle jointly affect depth, damage and final electrical behavior

body.zh: 风险提示；错误离子；束流不稳；区域错误；能量或剂量偏离
body.en: Risk reminder Wrong ion species Unstable beam Wrong region Energy or dose deviation

body.zh: 量测反馈：剂量记录 / SIMS / 片阻 / 电性；工艺结果
body.en: Metrology feedback: dose records / SIMS / sheet resistance / electrical Process result

body.zh: SIMS；浓度；深度；验证掺杂分布
body.en: SIMS Concentration Depth Validate dopant distribution

body.zh: 片阻；评估电学特性
body.en: Sheet resistance Evaluate electrical properties

body.zh: 电性；判断器件性能
body.en: Electrical Assess device performance

body.zh: 反馈优化工艺参数
body.en: Feed back to optimize process parameters
